items.markdown:
Salmon sperm skincare uses **PDRN** (polydeoxyribonucleotide), a purified DNA fragment extracted from salmon sperm cells, to promote skin regeneration, boost collagen production, and reduce inflammation.[[1]](https://metroderm.org/salmon-sperm-facial-what-it-is-how-it-works-and-why-its-the-next-big-thing-in-anti-aging-skin-care/)[[2]](https://www.getrael.com/blogs/r-blog/what-is-salmon-sperm-and-how-is-it-used-in-skincare)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/lR_chlDaX2c)

### What It Is and How It Works

- **The Ingredient:** PDRN is not raw sperm; it is heavily purified fish DNA stripped of proteins and cellular debris so it is safe and biocompatible with human skin.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/lR_chlDaX2c)[[2]](https://metroderm.org/salmon-sperm-facial-what-it-is-how-it-works-and-why-its-the-next-big-thing-in-anti-aging-skin-care/)
- **The Mechanism:** The DNA fragments mimic the body's natural cellular repair signals, encouraging fibroblasts (skin cells) to rebuild collagen, improve elasticity, and heal damaged tissue.[[1]](https://glowspaseattle.com/blog/science-behind-pdrn-skin-repair/)[[2]](https://www.healthline.com/health/salmon-sperm-facial)
- **Application Types:** 
	- **Topical Serums & Masks:** Over-the-counter products (like hydrogel face masks and daily ampoules) provide surface-level hydration, barrier support, and a temporary "glass skin" glow.
	- **In-Office Procedures:** Often known as a **[Salmon Sperm Facial](https://www.everydayhealth.com/skin-care/what-is-a-salmon-sperm-facial/)** , PDRN is paired with microneedling, lasers, or microinjections to push the molecules deeper into the dermis.[[1]](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/shopping/salmon-sperm-skin-care-rcna227796)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:15196674854435144189,catalogid:7261992847333125982,gpcid:13877984981974003144,mid:576462548987933648&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.getrael.com/blogs/r-blog/what-is-salmon-sperm-and-how-is-it-used-in-skincare)[[4]](https://www.healthline.com/health/salmon-sperm-facial)[[5]](https://www.everydayhealth.com/skin-care/what-is-a-salmon-sperm-facial/)

### Benefits and Limitations

- **Reported Benefits:** Smoother skin texture, diminished fine lines, reduced redness, and faster post-procedure healing.[[1]](https://www.hazanyderm.com/blog/salmon-sperm-the-new-trend-in-skincare)[[2]](https://www.healthline.com/health/salmon-sperm-facial)
- **The Evidence Gap:** While clinical research shows promise for medical wound healing and deeper injections, large-scale clinical validation for anti-aging cosmetic results is still limited.[[1]](https://www.everydayhealth.com/skin-care/what-is-a-salmon-sperm-facial/)[[2]](https://www.healthline.com/health/salmon-sperm-facial)[[3]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DcoaboOk08s/)
- **FDA Status:** Injected PDRN treatments are popular internationally (especially in South Korea) and at specialized med spas, though specific PDRN injectables may not hold FDA clearance for aesthetic use in the United States.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DcoaboOk08s/)[[2]](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/shopping/salmon-sperm-skin-care-rcna227796)

### Costs and Common Formulations

- **At-Home Products:** Ranging from $15 to $65 for items like STARSKIN hydrogel masks or [Stayve/PDRN booster ampoules Go to product viewer dialog for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,imageDocid:8790436468229722163,gpcid:560202586063291131,headlineOfferDocid:10667102463809135051,catalogid:7186548956346444780,productDocid:629263325941758230,rds:PC_560202586063291131%7CPROD_PC_560202586063291131&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwikwPH606yXAxXGV0EAHWMAHzAQxa4PegoIAggACAEIKBAd).[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:15196674854435144189,catalogid:7261992847333125982,gpcid:13877984981974003144,mid:576462548987933648&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:629263325941758230,catalogid:7186548956346444780,gpcid:560202586063291131&ibp=oshop)
- **In-Office Treatments:** Ranging from $500 to $1,000 per session depending on the provider and whether it is combined with microneedling or lasers.[[1]](https://www.everydayhealth.com/skin-care/what-is-a-salmon-sperm-facial/)
- **Safety Risks:** Generally well-tolerated, though users with severe fish allergies or active skin infections should avoid it, and in-office procedures can cause temporary redness, swelling, or bruising.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/health/salmon-sperm-facial)[[2]](https://www.everydayhealth.com/skin-care/what-is-a-salmon-sperm-facial/)
